# CANDIDATE: VOLUME_FILTER_BEARISH_REJECTION

**Filed:** 2026-07-12  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Adding a volume filter requiring the entry bar volume to exceed the 20-bar average will reduce false signals in BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON by filtering low-volume breakdowns prone to failure. This aims to improve edge_capture on J's winner days while maintaining or reducing losses on loser days by avoiding weak entries.

## Mechanism

Entry bar volume (3-min bar at trigger) must be > 1.0 × 20-bar average volume (calculated on prior bars only, excluding current bar to avoid look-ahead). Applied as an additional context filter in BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON after existing filters (time, structure, ribbon, news, loss budget, ribbon spread, VIX). Exit logic unchanged: chart stop primary, chandelier profit-lock, premium stop catastrophe cap, time stop 15:50 ET.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account realizes ~14% of headline P&L (per OP-20 disclosure #1).
2. **Sample bias:** Stage-1 uses full 16-month dataset (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18); overfit risk mitigated by planned OOS walk-forward and real-fills validation. Sample size: ~345 trading days.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window pending).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (top 3 J days validation pending).
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: Potential loss if volume filter rejects a valid winner (e.g., 5/04 if breakdown bar volume < avg).
   - Max drawdown: Could increase if filter causes missed winners during volatile regimes.
   - Blow-up scenario: Persistent low-volume market regime causing filter to reject most signals, leading to zero trades and opportunity cost.
6. **Concentration:** To be computed after Stage-1; will report top-5 days % of P&L if candidate advances.

## Pre-merge gate

- Stage-1 backtest with volume filter must pass gym validators (81/81).
- OOS walk-forward must show positive edge_capture and WF ratio ≥ 0.70.
- Real-fills validation on top 3 J days must show < ±20% diff vs BS-sim.
- Anchor no-regression: must not lose any J winner (engine MUST take all 3 winner days).
- Concentration check: top-5 days ≤ 50% of P&L.

## Confidence

5 / 10 -- Volume filter is logical but untested; risks over-filtering winners in low-volume regimes. Based on similar filters (e.g., TBR_HIGH_VOL) showing concentration issues.
